name: reliquary
description: A skeleton kit for resurrecting dead software — and proving nothing was lost.

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run security:check && npx vitest run
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/card-catalogue && npm run build -w apps/parts-ledger
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/reliquary && tsc -p apps/card-catalogue && tsc -p apps/parts-ledger
